trans-unit.target: TEXT_DUNGEONXBM_00000_LOOSEFROX_000_000<tab>Pshhh... Shkohhh... The moment of truetruth. Let's go, Chewchum Popoto!
TEXT_DUNGEONXBM_00000_GUTTLER_000_100<tab>For eternity shalt thou know suffering. Beastmaster... Surrender thy soul!
TEXT_DUNGEONXBM_00000_GUTTLER_000_200<tab>Blood of mine enemy, brethren of spilt blood... With me, Lauda. We fight as one!
